caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with a square back and decorative elements. The wood of the chair is a light brown color, and the backrest features a rectangular frame enclosing an ornamental central motif resembling an urn with draped ribbons. The arms of the chair curve outward and are also made of wood. The seat is upholstered in a light green fabric with a subtle sheen, and the upholstery is secured underneath with a row of metallic tacks or nails. The chair has four legs, each of which is straight and tapers slightly towards the bottom, with fluted detailing along their length. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, allowing the details and colors of the chair to stand out. The drawing is framed by a simple pencil border, and there is a small,/cursive signature in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
